stem: Which sentence from the selection expresses the author’s opinion about the benefits of art gardens?

options.label: A
options.text: Some gardens have plants that grow food. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: People will spend more time in gardens with more things to see. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: Art gardens often become places where people can gather. (paragraph 3)

options.label: D
options.text: Maintaining an art garden does take effort, but creating a community space is worth it. (paragraph 5)
